sourcePrecedence.subject: Visual identity, vocabulary, and brand voice
sourcePrecedence.rule: Consume approved vocabulary and identity; this positioning source is not product behavior evidence.

sourcePrecedence.subject: Landing-page primary messaging and route composition
sourcePrecedence.rule: Landing owns page composition/runtime and consumes approved copy; the pinned source is docs-only, not a live route.

sourcePrecedence.subject: Demonstrated product behavior
sourcePrecedence.rule: This pinned revision is documentation-only. Use product release evidence for complete-app behavior; GT-10B evidence is limited to its scoped adapter.

sourcePrecedence.subject: Comparisons, evidence classification, and sponsor-use evidence
sourcePrecedence.rule: This evidence index is planned; it does not establish a completed comparison or sponsor result.

sourcePrecedence.subject: Financial definitions and actuals
sourcePrecedence.rule: Use source-owner evidence for actuals; definitions or a hypothetical export do not establish savings or forecasts.

evidenceClasses.name: Comparable improvement
evidenceClasses.requiredEvidence: Reproducible comparable baseline and candidate runs, owner-reviewed method, and pinned outputs.
evidenceClasses.claimUse: No improvement, time saved, cost saved, or efficiency result is approved while pending.

evidenceClasses.name: Evidence classification
evidenceClasses.requiredEvidence: Per-claim source, mode, limitations, and source-owner-reviewed evidence classification.
evidenceClasses.claimUse: Retain canonical labels simulated, sandbox, live, estimated, pending; mock and planned are additional copy states, not replacements.

evidenceClasses.name: Secrets and customer data
evidenceClasses.requiredEvidence: Sanitized review and source-owner scan evidence; no restricted original in this repository.
evidenceClasses.claimUse: No privacy, redaction, or security assurance claim is approved from policy text alone.

evidenceClasses.name: Neatlogs use
evidenceClasses.requiredEvidence: Neatlogs-specific integration/run evidence, sanitized output, mode, and owner review.

evidenceClasses.name: Entire use
evidenceClasses.requiredEvidence: Entire-specific checkpoint/graph evidence and owner review; do not substitute another sponsor's run.

evidenceClasses.name: CFO.ai use
evidenceClasses.requiredEvidence: Actual CFO.ai business-plan evidence and finance owner review; do not substitute a placeholder or estimate.

claims.allowedWording: “No forms: drop your ticket and it's done.” Brand positioning only; this is not evidence of autonomous completion or zero-input fulfillment.
prohibitedVariants: The ticket is fully automated from submission to resolution.
Drop any ticket and it is autonomously completed with no human input.
